description: This file contains command-line interface code for the 'openclaw-mac' application, specifically implementing the 'wizard' command. It includes options parsing, error handling, and the logic to communicate with a gateway server via WebSocket, manage wizard sessions, handle different wizard steps, and prompt the user for input during a wizard interaction.

classes.name: GatewayWizardClient
classes.description: An actor that manages WebSocket communication with the gateway server, handles connection, request/response messaging, and authentication for the wizard process.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments into a WizardCliOptions struct.

methods.name: runWizardCommand
methods.description: Main function to execute the 'wizard' command: handles options, initiates connection, and manages the wizard session lifecycle.
